selection_rule: Lexicographically first pair of listed 256-cubes sharing one face; chosen from directory names before payload acquisition.
purpose: Qualify sheet-ID continuity and topology metrics on a public development reference; not a model comparison or fresh evaluation.
axis_contract: Directory origins are Z,Y,X per upstream README; verify NRRD sizes and raw storage axes before joining.
limits: Manual harmonized sheet labels; small components were removed upstream. Unknown voxels and missing instances are not automatically physical negatives. Physical scanner placement/spacing not yet qualified.
